title: CLAIRE selected for AI and HPC funding
summary: CLAIRE, a collaboration with Hydrosat, has been selected for funding through the joint AI-HPC BRIDGES call. The project applies AI and high-performance computing to Earth observation imagery.

title: BrainSat receives a Marie Speyer Excellence Grant
summary: Flor Ortiz received a Marie Speyer Excellence Grant for BrainSat, supporting research into energy-efficient satellite processing. BrainSat is listed among the projects associated with the lab research themes.
